## Licensing

Personal and commercial use in up to 3 commercial projects per purchase. Modifications allowed (crop, colour grade, composite). Prohibited: resale or redistribution as stock photography, templates or asset packs; use in adult, escort, defamatory or political contexts; trademark registration; NFT minting.
